segments.title: Cold open
sentences: Here's a strange idea for a landing page.
Don't tell people about the instrument. Hand them one.
Eight keys. Five moods. No samples.
This is Wave, a synthesizer that lives entirely in the browser.
And everything you're about to see is drawn from the sound it makes.

segments.title: The signal
sentences: There is no waveform video playing on a loop. No pre-rendered spectrum.
The orb on the stage is reading the actual audio signal, sixty times a second, and painting what it finds.
The page isn't illustrating sound. It's listening to it.

segments.title: One voice
sentences: Follow one key press.
You hold the A key, and a voice wakes up.
Three oscillators: a saw, a triangle, a sine, tuned slightly apart so they shimmer against each other.
An envelope shapes the note. A fast attack, a decay to a sustain, and a long release when you let go.
Eight voices like this one can run at once.

segments.title: The shared chain
sentences: They all feed one shared chain.
A resonant low-pass filter.
A stereo ping-pong delay, and a convolution reverb built from a generated impulse response.
Then a soft clipper and a compressor, so a fistful of keys never turns into a mess.
At the end, an analyser takes a copy of the signal for the stage.

segments.title: The quiet trick
sentences: Notice where the mute switch sits. After the analyser.
So when you turn the sound off, the speakers go quiet, but the instrument keeps breathing on screen.
The visuals never lie, even in silence.

segments.title: Two views
sentences: The orb reads two views of the same signal.
The time domain, a waveform wrapped into a ring.
And the frequency domain, a spray of ticks for the energy in each band.
Springs smooth the level, the bass and the treble, so the motion has weight.
It settles, instead of twitching.

segments.title: The clock
sentences: Time is the other instrument.
The arpeggiator doesn't trust the page clock.
It looks a hundred and twenty milliseconds ahead, and schedules real notes on the audio clock, so the pattern stays steady even when the drawing gets busy.

segments.title: First Light is data
sentences: And the demo, First Light, isn't a recording either.
It's a list of note events, played through the same voices you play by hand.
The filter rides the arrangement. The moment you touch it, control comes back to you.

segments.title: Five moods
sentences: Five presets reshape the oscillators, the filter, the envelope, the delay and the space.
Each one also gets its own way of moving.
Glass shimmers. Tape drags. Haze drifts. Pulse snaps. Bloom breathes.

segments.title: A small instrument
sentences: All of it is TypeScript, Canvas and the Web Audio API.
No audio files, no runtime libraries, no backend.
Just a small instrument, with a page wrapped around it.
Hold a key, and the page answers.
